summary: Marion County, TN tower built around 1947 for the Division of Forestry; NRHP-listed 2021; standing, no longer continually manned, no public visiting arrangement found.

facts.design: Aermotor MC-39 type; sixty-foot galvanized steel truss frame with a seven-by-seven-foot observation cab

staffing.status: not continually manned since the mid-1970s; forestry staff climb it occasionally to spot fires

access.note: State-owned Division of Forestry site; the nomination describes ongoing staff use and gives no public visiting arrangement

events.note: State of Tennessee signed a contract with G. Sherman and the heirs of A.R. Hall on September 1, 1934, for two leased parcels; a deed from them to the state of 1934 is on record (Deed Book XXX, pp. 263-265)
Constructed ca. 1947 by the Tennessee Division of Forestry. The nomination calls 1947 an estimate and says Division documents suggest 1948
Constantly manned in the high fire season until the 1970s; no longer continually manned after the mid-1970s (year is approximate)
Radio tower and equipment building added nearby inside a barbed-wire fence (ca. 2010 per nomination); two modern radio antennae added to the tower (the nomination does not date the antennae)
Listed on the National Register of Historic Places on June 28, 2021

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The nomination dates construction to ca. 1947 and says Division documents suggest 1948; the tower first appears on a 1947 USGS map. The story uses ca. 1947 and reports both.
The nomination gives its period of significance as ca. 1947-1971 in one place and ca. 1948-1975 in another. Not used in the story; flagged for the editor.

sources.title: Big Hill Fire Lookout Tower, National Register of Historic Places nomination

notes_for_editor: Access level 'restricted' is inferred from state ownership and the nomination's account of staff use; no visiting rules were found. Staffing as_of uses the 2021 nomination. The brief record had no height; 60 ft (18.3 m) comes from the nomination. The nomination text gives two construction-related dates (1947 and 1948) and two period-of-significance end dates (1971 and 1975), so check the PDF before relying on either. Story not verified on site. The npgallery entry for NRIS 100006708 returned no content; the tn.gov nomination was read instead.
